quarterly_data.quarter: Mistral press release: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mistral is collaborating with NVIDIA on AI-native engineering workflows (Mistral Large 4 with Mistral's data generation and physics modeling pipelines, accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries and NVIDIA Warp) and on public benchmarks and open datasets for physics models and for agentic AI in CAE and EDA; the companies previously co-developed Mistral NeMo and are working through the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition on a frontier base model. Mistral Large 4 (public preview), its largest model, has approximately 1 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active parameters and was trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral-operated data centers in Europe; Mistral is bringing additional NVIDIA-powered AI infrastructure online in support of its compute roadmap targeting 1 GW of capacity by 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 1 trillion total / 49 billion active parameters; 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs; 1 GW of capacity by 2030 (target)
